notes:
[P1 ops manager, 80 people] Expense reports take me two days a month. People lose receipts. I would pay to not chase them.
[P2 ops lead, 150 people] Month-end is two days of chasing receipts and fixing categories. Our tool is fine but nobody uses it.
[P3 founder, 12 people] We do not really have expenses, everyone has a card and I check the statement.
[P4 finance, 300 people] Approvals are the slow part, not capture. Managers sit on them for a week.
questions: Is month-end expense work a real pain worth paying for? Where exactly is the time lost?
